context: Tests that when a demo branch for the requested brand already exists, the agent checks for it and ASKS continue-vs-new rather than silently reusing or recreating it, never deletes the existing branch/PR (I5), and does not start design work before resolving the question.

checklist.name: Detects the existing brand demo and asks continue-vs-new
checklist.description: The agent recognizes an Acme demo is already in progress and asks the customer whether to continue on it or start a fresh one, instead of silently reusing/recreating it.

checklist.name: Never deletes/closes the existing branch or PR
checklist.description: The agent does not run or propose gh pr close, --delete-branch, git branch -D, git push --delete, or any command destroying the existing branch/PR.

checklist.name: Fresh path is a new non-colliding branch + new PR
checklist.description: If starting fresh, the proposed path creates a new non-colliding branch (e.g. demo/acme-2) and a new PR, leaving the existing one intact.

checklist.name: No design work before the branch question is resolved
checklist.description: The agent does not invoke the design tool or edit styling files before the continue-vs-new question is answered.

checklist.name: Plain language, no internal terms
checklist.description: No 'branch', 'PR', 'daFolder', or phase names surfaced to the customer as mechanics.
